morgan: yes please @rory, docs-bot reminds us to include owner. Also some hits are inside sample outputs, don't replace those. I used this quick filter to avoid fenced outputs: `python - <<'PY'
import sys,re
for f in sys.argv[1:]:
  s=open(f).read()
  if re.search(r"curl .*short\\.rwd", s) and "```" not in s:
    print(f)
PY`
